scope: Read-only audit of four existing actual 480-frame candidate reports; no new repair or fade parameter sweep
method: Reconstruct rigid bone-world transforms from reported positions/quaternions, apply actual loaded inverse bind and identity mesh bind, reproduce Three column-normalized skin quaternion decomposition; compare chest-relative arm directions and elbow positions independently. Retained per-bone nonuniform scale is tiny and not fully recorded in reports, so reconstruction is bounded correspondence, not an exact full-matrix capture.

debugDifferenceDetails.note: Only floating-point residuals differ from isolated CPU key reconstruction; actual candidate versus matched baseline report remains exactly equal.

finding: All52 full/zero switches per480 frames are independently reproduced from retained actual bone orientations. Each switch crosses a substantial chest-relative arm-pose change: combined four-feature travel at least0.349rad, at least one arm-axis change0.192rad, and at least one elbow moving5.06mm. Quaternion sign is removed by absolute-dot geodesic angles; camera/world transforms cancel in chest-relative features. Tiny decomposition/scale differences are below1e-6rad and do not explain jumps. The four-key compact support crosses full and zero within one recorded interval when actual arm rotations/IK directions move substantially. This audit does not isolate why the upstream arm solver produced those changes.
specificAlternative: Retain the connected source-space full sleeve geometry selection, but author anatomically smooth shoulder-upperArm-forearm-cuff skin weights independently of corrupted existing weight eligibility. Keep source shoulder/cuff/hood and grip contacts exact; validate those weights in actual motion before local source sculpt or small corrective shapes. Avoid using large ARAP deformations to carry a bad underlying bind/weight field.
limits: No new model, morphology, rig weights, physics, fade radii, browser or GPU workload.
Parent owns visual verdict. Upstream IK pole/roll instability is a hypothesis requiring its own evidence; this audit establishes resulting actual bone-pose changes only.
The observed pose changes may be continuous over10 physics substeps per video frame. A solver discontinuity requires finer pose evidence, not these12fps reports.
